eventMetadata.context_description: Latest forecasts from the Israel Meteorological Service and supporting international models converge on a daytime maximum of 29–30°C for Tel Aviv on June 5, consistent with early-June climatology of 28–30°C under moderate northerly flow and Mediterranean sea-breeze moderation. This alignment of official guidance and historical analogs has positioned 30°C as the dominant market outcome at 59.5% implied probability, with 29°C and 31°C capturing the remaining spread from minor timing variations in peak heating. No Sharav or strong easterly advection is indicated in current runs, keeping probabilities for 32°C or higher below 3%. Traders are monitoring afternoon observations and any final Israel Meteorological Service revisions for resolution, as coastal influences typically limit daily variability absent anomalous synoptic patterns.
